items.claim: Milos Janicic constantly walks forward and applies pressure, never taking a backward step.
items.quote: He walks forward the entire fight. From Montenegro, this is a guy though who is never taking a back step. He is walking you down looking to knock you out at all times possible.

items.claim: Milos Janicic has only gone to the third round three times in his 22-fight professional career.
items.quote: The guy has had 22 professional fights and he's been to a third round [only three times]
